text: One morning the Monarchs arrived. <break time="0.8s" /> To find Miss Churm and Oronte. <break time="0.8s" /> Already posing together. <break time="0.8s" /> And the Major. <break time="0.8s" /> Standing in silence. <break time="0.8s" /> Seemed to understand at last. <break time="0.8s" /> What their presence in my studio meant. <break time="0.8s" /> Then, remarking that the girls hair might be better done. <break time="0.8s" /> Missus Monarch went over to Miss Churm. <break time="0.8s" /> And, with a few quick touches. <break time="0.8s" /> Made her head twice as charming as before. <break time="0.8s" /> It was a small act. <break time="0.8s" /> But it was the service of a ladys maid. <break time="0.8s" /> Not of a lady. <break time="0.8s" /> And seeing it. <break time="0.8s" /> I felt something tighten in my throat. <break time="0.8s" /> That I could not quite name. <break time="0.8s" /> Then, while I worked. <break time="0.8s" /> The Major and his wife quietly washed up my crockery. <break time="0.8s" /> And put it away. <break time="0.8s" /> And Missus Monarch picked up a dirty rag. <break time="0.8s" /> That had dropped from my paint box. <break time="0.8s" /> I say, can I not be useful here. <break time="0.8s" /> The Major asked at last. <break time="0.8s" /> And in that question I heard. <break time="0.8s" /> What they could not bring themselves to say aloud. <break time="0.8s" /> Take us on, and we will do anything. <break time="0.8s" /> They had accepted their failure. <break time="0.8s" /> But they could not accept their fate. <break time="0.8s" /> And for a moment. <break time="0.8s" /> As I watched them. <break time="0.8s" /> My drawing blurred before my eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> And the whole picture swam. <break time="0.8s" /> I kept them for a week. <break time="0.8s" /> But it was a pity I could not bear. <break time="0.8s" /> And at last I gave them a sum of money. <break time="0.8s" /> To go away. <break time="0.8s" /> And I never saw them again. <break time="0.8s" /> Hawley still insists. <break time="0.8s" /> That the Monarchs did me a permanent harm. <break time="0.8s" /> And led me into false ways. <break time="0.8s" /> And if that be true. <break time="0.8s" /> I am content to have paid the price, for the memory.
